pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Lutikov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 3 gave a Bc2-d1-h5 manoeuvre. Rewrote plans 1 and 3. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Pilnik Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the f3-knight via f1 to g3 or e3; plan 2 gave ...Na5-c5 and a b8-knight that is on c6. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Suetin Variation
pages.notes: Overview missed the point of 9.a3 (a retreat on a2 against ...Na5); plan 1 sent the knight to f5 via d2-f1-e3. Rewrote overview and plan 1. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, 8...d6 9.a4
pages.notes: Overview said a4 prevents ...b4; plan 1 played Nbd2 before the d-pawn moved; plan 2 aimed at an a6-pawn that is exchanged; plan 3 gave ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6; plan 4 gave ...c5-c4 through the c6-knight. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, 8...d6 9.a4 Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nbd2 with the pawn on d2; plan 3 had White recapture gxf3 to open the g-file; plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight that is on c6 (first plan 1 rewrite rejected as self-contradictory about the a-file; corrected and accepted). Rewrote all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Lutikov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the bishop via d1 to e3; plan 2 gave ...Na5-c4 and ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6. Rewrote plans 1-2 around the main reply ...d5. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Pilnik, 11.Nbd2 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave ...exd4 with no pawn on d4; plan 3 pushed d5 from d3. Rewrote plans 2-3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Pilnik, 11.Nbd2 Qc7
pages.notes: Plans 1-2 had the knight and the d4 break in an order the board did not allow. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Pilnik, 12.Nf1 Bf8
pages.notes: Plan 2 sent pieces to '...Bg7 or ...d7' with the bishop on f8 needing ...g6. Rewrote plan 2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Pilnik, 9...h6
pages.notes: Overview called 9.d4 the main line; plan 4 gave ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6. Rewrote overview and plan 4. British spelling.
